decisions.summary: Preferences may queue offline mutations with a stable mutation ID and expected version, visibly pending until server confirmation.
Security and Billing mutations are online-only; neither may be queued or represented as locally successful.
Appearance remains device-local and uses the existing theme capability.
Shared queue storage/principal binding, unsynced preference sign-out policy, legacy notification import and native restart recovery need Platform/Product owner decisions.
Profile offline draft behavior is a safe assumption; provider concurrency and Files avatar upload/recovery need owner confirmation.

actions: Separated connectivity, business state, entity sync state and mutation state.
Defined per-operation local/offline behavior for Profile, avatar, Preferences, appearance, Security, Billing and tenant/identity changes.
Inspected current local preferences/theme storage, Settings adapters, Auth sync policy and generic mobile mutation queue.
Specified retries, conflict resolution, migration, reconciliation, recovery and multiplatform sync test cases.

validation.evidence: Auth sync, local Settings/preferences/theme storage and offline queue were inspected; sync-design.md records their limits and the account-specific policy.

requirements.evidence: sync-design.md separates connectivity, business, entity-sync and mutation state.
sync-design.md defines local/offline read and write behavior for each Account operation on all required platforms.
sync-design.md covers retry, conflict, identity/tenant switch, reload, reinstall, event reconciliation and rollback.
Queue storage/principal binding, pending preference handling, migration, avatar Files lifecycle and provider concurrency remain open with named owners.

notes: The existing generic mobile offline queue uses web localStorage/process memory and is not yet safe for Account user-scoped mutations; it is recorded as a shared capability gap, not used or modified.
No Account-local queue, storage adapter, provider integration, endpoint or production code was created.
Open decisions must be resolved or explicitly deferred by their accountable owners before starting 06-plan under the traceability gate.
